acceptanceCriteria.text: Independent-root and fork checkpoint records persist and reload across Manager restart.
Two execution records can share one `prefix_id` with distinct `execution_state_id` values.
Changed bound repository/task/artifact generation marks/rejects stale parent reuse.
Missing/corrupt parent fails boundedly without inventing ancestry.
Agent/model/profile changes outside Canon do not alter persisted `prefix_id`.
Existing Manager session persistence remains compatible.
No production path creates/reserves/cleans worktrees/branches or launches Zellij/Nawabari children.

issue.title: feat(manager): persist versioned Canon checkpoints and execution lineage
